theme.name: Emerald & Slate Medical-Tech
theme.mode: Light / Dark hybrid (Slate 900 dark ops, Pure White / Slate 50 clean clinical light mode)

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Barlow, Outfit, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and switches (min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px])
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid for high impact ops, High Density compact Grid for Clinical & Admin tables
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Cards & containers MUST have p-4 to p-6 internal padding. Never let text collide with borders

surfaces_and_elevation.header_nav: bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 text-white z-50 sticky top-0 (NEVER 100% transparent)
surfaces_and_elevation.dropdowns_and_modals: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden z-50
surfaces_and_elevation.dashboard_cards: bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700/60 shadow-sm p-4 sm:p-6 hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors
surfaces_and_elevation.print_sheets: A4 prescription template 210mm x 297mm strict white background black text print-friendly layout, 58mm thermal slip template max-w-[220px]

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and buttons
accessibility_and_testing.hover_focus_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover/focus (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, forms, buttons, inputs, tabs, status badges, and metrics MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes

key_design_principles: Follow Emerald & Slate medical-tech theme strictly.
Ensure all buttons and touch controls meet 44x44px minimum touch target size for mobile/tablet operations in physical camps.
Support USB wedge Aadhaar QR scanning & camera scanning mock workflows cleanly.
Implement crisp 2-state patient lifecycle visualization (Registered -> Seen) with undo and recovery capabilities.
Provide clear role-aware interfaces: Admin, Team Lead, Volunteer, Clinical Desk Operator, and Patient self-registration view.
Design A4 print sheet and 58mm thermal slip preview modal / dedicated printable views.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on headers, navbars, or select dropdown overlays.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements for automated test coverage.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) with explicit background opacity.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Specify specific transition properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Always use modern pill-shaped or sharp crisp button styles with interaction micro-animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for UI icons. Use Lucide icons or SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, visual feedback.
Use generous spacing (2-3x typical spacing) to ensure clean readability on mobile & tablet displays.
Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every interactive or status element.
